text: There are several reasons. It's usually cheaper, since you don't need a passport or a flight, and you can easily travel by car or train. Some people also feel more comfortable because they speak the language and know the culture. Personally, I like discovering my own country, because there are many places I haven't seen yet, and it feels good to support local businesses.

tips.en: Cause and result make the reasoning logical.
tips.kk: Себеп пен салдар пайымдауды логикалы етеді.
tips.ru: Причина и следствие делают рассуждение логичным.
tips.example: since you don't need a passport or a flight

tips.en: A personal conclusion naturally closes a general answer.
tips.kk: Соңындағы жеке қорытынды жалпы жауапты табиғи аяқтайды.
tips.ru: Личный вывод в конце естественно завершает общий ответ.
tips.example: Personally, I like discovering my own country

questions.question: Why do some people prefer to holiday in their own country?

text: They've made travelling accessible to far more people, so a weekend trip to another country is now quite common. That's brilliant for broadening horizons, but it also means more pollution and overcrowded tourist spots. Some cities, like Venice, have even started limiting visitors. In my view, we should enjoy cheap flights responsibly, perhaps by travelling less often but staying longer.

tips.en: A plus and a minus in one sentence show balance.
tips.kk: Бір сөйлемдегі артықшылық пен кемшілік теңгерімді көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Плюс и минус в одном предложении показывают баланс.
tips.example: That's brilliant for broadening horizons, but it also means more pollution and overcrowded tourist spots

tips.en: A concrete example makes the answer convincing and shows the idea is grounded.
tips.kk: Нақты мысал жауапты сенімді етіп, ойдың негізді екенін көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Конкретный пример делает ответ убедительным и показывает, что мысль не пустая.
tips.example: Some cities, like Venice, have even started limiting visitors

text: I'd say it needs a mix of attractions, such as beautiful scenery, interesting history and good food. Practical things matter too, like safe streets, reliable transport and friendly people. For me, atmosphere is the key factor. A place can be famous, but if it feels too commercial, I lose interest. I'd choose a quiet town with character over a crowded landmark any day.

questions.question: What makes a good tourist destination?

text: I doubt it'll become popular any time soon, since tickets currently cost hundreds of thousands of dollars. Only very wealthy people can afford it. In the long term, prices might fall as the technology develops, just like air travel did. But there are also safety and environmental concerns, so I think it'll remain a niche activity for several decades. Personally, I'd rather spend that money on exploring our own planet.

tips.en: Hedging sounds natural and shows you are weighing the opinion.
tips.kk: Сақ тұжырым табиғи естіледі және пікірді саралап жатқаныңызды көрсетеді.
